column1: # assets/SOURCES.tsv: where every data file the repository ships comes from, and under which terms.
# `og dev licences check` (rust/crates/og-dev/src/licences.rs, run by the Lint workflow) fails when a
# file under assets/ has no row, a file is in two rows, a row matches no file, a header phrase is not in
# its file, or NOTICE does not name a third-party row. A change that adds a file under assets/ adds its
# row here in the same pull request; one that adds third-party data also names it in NOTICE.
#   path     the file, relative to the repository root; a folder when it ends with / (every file below).
#            Every file under assets/ needs a row; a row elsewhere (a test fixture) is checked the same
#            way, but files outside assets/ need none.
#   source   where the data comes from: who made it and where it was taken. A source that starts with
#            "OwnGenome" is our own work (written here, or curated here from facts the source names);
#            any other row is a third party's, and NOTICE must name its path.
#   version  the release, commit or date the data was taken at; - for our own files.
#   licence  the terms the data comes under: an SPDX id, or the source's own words for data with no
#            licence (public domain, open access, short quotations). Never -, unknown or empty.
#   header   a phrase the file's opening # lines must carry word for word (line breaks and runs of
#            blanks count as one space), several split by |; - when the file carries no header
#            (a binary file, JSON, a format whose readers take every line, a byte-for-byte copy).
